headline: Iraq Boosts Oil Exports to 3.6 Million Barrels Per Day
summary: Iraq has increased its oil exports to 3.6 million barrels per day as OPEC's second-largest producer seeks higher production capacity and quota baselines. The country also plans to acquire ten new oil tankers for its fleet.
why: Iraq is a key member of OPEC; shifts in its export volumes and production targets influence global crude oil supply dynamics and oil prices.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Changes in OPEC member export volumes directly affect international crude supply and pricing.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Higher output and export figures from major Middle Eastern producers like Iraq directly impact global crude availability and market sentiment.
